text:
Jordan: Quick capture from today's Nexus private deploy sync — small list of items we still need to close before cutover.
Priya: thanks — pasted notes from the call below.
Priya: 1) Ingress/egress: Nexus wants a single outbound NAT + corporate egress proxy. Can we confirm recommended ephemeral port ranges and whether we need extra SG rules? @kevin_netops
kevin_netops: They run behind an ALB + NATGW. We typically allow ephemeral 1024-65535 outbound. If Nexus ops want tighter, we can recommend 32768-61000 and document tradeoffs (connection re-use, timeout).
Anya_secops: KMS question: customer wants us to hold decrypt but not be able to rotate keys. We need to confirm key policy shape and whether they require HSM-backed CMK. Also: what audit logs are we sending to their SIEM? Audit events only or full request logs?
elena_sre: We currently forward VPC flow logs + platform audit events to their Splunk HTTPS endpoint. Initial bandwidth estimate ~200MB/day; can spike during ramp. Retention default is 365d on our side, they asked for 90d.
Jordan: Action items (short): a) @kevin_netops confirm port ranges and health-check ports; b) @anya_secops draft KMS key policy template for Nexus; c) @elena_sre share flow-log mapping and retention implications.
kevin_netops: For ALB -> task health checks we need TCP/8080 open from ALB SG to instance SG. Need to confirm container bind port (8080 vs 8081) with Nexus app team.
Priya: Nexus dev replied: container listens on 8080. They also asked for a cross-account IAM role so their SEC team can pull logs. Proposed role ARN: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/Redwood-Nexus-LogIngest (we will redact acct in public docs).
Anya_secops: That role looks fine. I'll add a condition on aws:SourceVpc and aws:SourceIp to narrow access, and grant kms:Decrypt only to our service principal. Also recommend adding aws:RequestedRegion condition if they restrict regions.
Jordan: Commercial note: Nexus is asking for a 12-month commit but has a renewal question around model quantization and unit costs. Mark renewal risk as "medium" until we confirm quantization availability and perf delta.
Priya: Added renewal risk to CS tracker with tags: quantization, pricing, kms-policy. I'll draft the follow-up email with the three config snippets.
kevin_netops: HSM? They don't need HSM this phase. We'll use a CMK with customer as key owner; our principal will be added for decrypt. Rotation will be manual for now per their compliance ask.
elena_sre: Regarding Splunk retention: reducing to 90d is doable, but legal flagged PII concerns if we shorten platform retention. @anya_secops can you confirm with legal and ops?
Anya_secops: I'll raise with Legal today and loop in Risk. If legal ok, I'll update key policy and log-sharing SOP.
Priya: Follow-ups I'll include in the email: 1) SG rules + ephemeral ranges, 2) IAM role template + trust policy, 3) KMS policy draft + HSM note, 4) flow log mapping + retention options. Expect email by EOD. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Cutover checklist updated: items added by priya at 2898765432
Jordan: Thanks everyone — closing this capture. Re-open thread if any blocker surfaces.
